reason: The estimate holds up when I add all the pre-period controls (lagged export growth, region, sector, listed status and the 2020 firm characteristics): the coefficient is 0.69 (p=0.004), against 0.70 in the report. The post-period variable buyer_rating_2023 is correctly left out as a likely mediator or collider. The 1% outcome trim is minor, and a positive effect is supported, though it rests on observational data.
